findings.reason: OPEN; AMBIGUOUS. F0003:S3:T6:A59 identifies individual septic rats, A61 describes separate treatment groups, and A64:A75 supplies Subject labels 1 through 12. The page does not establish globally unique animal identifiers or cross-group correspondence. Reported attainment values are modeled summaries, not measured concentrations. Detection limits, censoring rules, substituted-limit handling and uncertainty definitions are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Before QC, preserve each source subject label with its treatment-column identity without inventing animal IDs or cross-group links. Obtain source-supported identifier mapping and any applicable assay-limit, censoring and uncertainty documentation before relying on those fields.

findings.reason: OPEN; UNRESOLVED. A61 supports neutropenic infected rats receiving repeat s.c. regimens; A62 supports meropenem measurements in tail-vein whole blood. The page does not explicitly establish unchanged-drug assay specificity, the definition of f, measured versus assumed free concentrations, binding inputs or chemical dose basis. These cannot be supplied from the fT notation alone.
findings.needed_material: Retain whole blood, septic/neutropenic state and s.c. repeat dosing as distinct contexts. Obtain the analyte assay definition, dose basis and source-supported free-exposure or binding definition before using these values as verified free-meropenem exposures.

findings.reason: OPEN; UNRESOLVED. A62 supplies sampling volume and times but explicitly states that the underlying concentrations are in Supplementary Table S1, which is not accessible. The percentage summaries are available; raw concentration-profile inputs and their individual regimen linkage are unavailable in this supplied page.
findings.needed_material: Obtain readable authorized Supplementary Table S1 and its subject/regimen mapping if profile reconstruction or independent exposure calculation is required. Preserve the reported percentages separately with their current evidence status.

findings.reason: OPEN; UNRESOLVED. B63:E63 and body values establish percentage outputs and distinguish MIC from 4 × MIC thresholds. A61 states a 12 h treatment period, but the percentage calculation denominator, exposure-window boundaries, time origin and numeric MIC threshold are NOT_FOUND. The treatment duration cannot automatically define the attainment calculation window.
findings.needed_material: Obtain the source definition of each percentage, its calculation window and time origin, the numeric threshold and its relationship to the strain MIC. Keep the 4 × MIC column distinct from the MIC-threshold columns.

findings.reason: OPEN; NOT_FOUND in the supplied page. findings.needed_material: Obtain the strain-matched meropenem MIC result, units, measurement context and source-supported relationship to this infection experiment before MIC-dependent index analysis.

findings.reason: OPEN; UNRESOLVED. A61 provides inoculum, i.p. infection, neutropenia, infection-to-treatment interval, treatment duration, saline controls and 7-day mortality monitoring. Headers vary dose and interval. Organism/strain, an explicitly identified infection site, individual mortality observations, response-reference definitions and regimen-exposure-response links are NOT_FOUND. Saline treatment context does not supply untreated growth measurements, and varied regimens alone do not establish separation of the candidate indices.
findings.needed_material: Obtain source-linked organism/strain and infection-site definitions, observed mortality records and their animal/regimen links, endpoint timing/reference definitions and applicable control observations. Assess design separation downstream without fitting or ranking at this step.

findings.reason: OPEN; UNRESOLVED. A61 describes mortality monitoring, while B64:E75 contains exposure-attainment percentages. No bacterial-burden responses, stasis, 1-log or 2-log kill targets, or mortality-linked efficacy target are supplied. The printed attainment percentages cannot establish any of these effects.
findings.needed_material: Keep mortality/survival separate from bacterial burden. Obtain matched endpoint-specific response evidence and desired-effect definitions for any proposed target estimation; do not transfer these exposure labels to CFU kill targets or another organism or infection site.
